corpusDescription: One ordered process pass after known heavy validation jobs stopped, using clean commit da4f5beb37f41228c0aaec249ea9b76a8a41bb92. Same frozen 52 diagnostic cases, 24 capacity cases, and two 199900-character normalized-envelope boundaries as the original timing pass. Includes lazy first-use work inside encode/decode calls; module imports and synchronous asset loading occur before those calls. No repeated statistical benchmark or mobile-browser latency guarantee. Input bytes, model, prior policy and wire are unchanged; only the exact-output legacy radix runtime conversion is optimized. Source/formatter/WASM hashes and whole-process peak RSS are recorded.
measurement: Every character in the complete URL-serialized Markdown link is counted. Only exact normalized-envelope round trips count as successful. codec is transport metadata; all other schema fields and UTF-16 code units are compared.

variants.label: optimized
variants.wasmLoading: The unchanged brotli-wasm ESM/browser binary is read locally through a file: fetch adapter. No native-zlib substitute.
variants.framing: [View](https://agent-render.com/#...); real URL serialization and production Markdown formatter
variants.timing: One ordered pass including cold first-sample costs; indicative CPU timings, not a statistically repeated latency benchmark.
